Monday Mood — Listing Rewrite Sample

Live App Store app by Fortune Insight, LLC · View on App Store

This is an editorial sample showing how a generic draft can be tightened. The “after” version reflects the spirit of the current live listing — not a paid client deliverable. No reviews or ratings are quoted; the app has not received enough public ratings to display an overview.

Subtitle (30 characters)

Before — vague

Daily mood tracker app

After — specific ritual + audience

Daily office mood ritual

Description (opening paragraph)

Before — feature list, no hook

Monday Mood is a mood app. Track your mood every day. Includes widgets, reminders, streaks, and in-app purchases. Download now.

After — one ritual, one promise, honest limits

Monday Mood is a tiny daily ritual for office weather. Open the app once a day. Get today’s mood — Peak, Clear, Steady, Foggy, or Rough — plus a short line in Sunday-scaries English. Same device, same day, same answer. No refresh luck. No account. FREE FOREVER • Offline daily draw • Share or save today’s mood card • Home Screen widget + optional reminder • Streak for coming back tomorrow Your daily draw and share card are free forever. Unlock Lifetime with a one-time purchase for full mood history and premium card themes. No subscription. For entertainment only. Not advice, not fortune-telling, not productivity tracking.

Why these changes

  • Lead with the daily ritual, not “mood tracker” ( crowded category )
  • Name the five mood states early — searchable, memorable
  • Separate free vs Lifetime clearly; say “no subscription” upfront
  • Disclaimer matches app category expectations ( entertainment, not medical )
